I also listed every entry at Likelihood 3 or higher with more than one Status line, since the checker only reads the last one. There are 36 of them, and every one ends on a settled status. In the table, "Likelihood" is the L column. I took "current" to mean the last Status line in the file. I didn't check each entry's Verified line myself beyond the checker's presence test, and I cut the long status texts short.
